ns2:course.label: Phases and Phase Relations
ns2:course.description: Understanding microstructure. Quantitative examination of phases (crystalline and non-crystalline structures) and the relationships between phases (phase diagrams). Commercial practices for producing desired microscopic phase configurations and macroscopic shapes (processing). Credit is not given for both MSE 201 and MSE 280. Prerequisite: CHEM 104, MATH 241, MSE 182, and PHYS 212.
